**Weather:** -3-2°C, 60% rain, daylight 09:41-17:52

**Lodging:** Boutique hotel in downtown Reykjavik — $220 — Central base for all 4 nights; walking distance to restaurants, easy access to Golden Circle and peninsula routes.

- **09:00 AM — Breakfast in downtown Reykjavik** (food, 45 min, $30, 64.1450, -21.9300)
  why: Fuel up before a full day of driving through Iceland's most famous route — hearty start for winter sightseeing.
  note: Cafes around Laugavegur open early; grab pastries and coffee before driving northeast to Golden Circle.

- **10:30 AM — Þingvellir National Park** (other, 90 min, $0, 64.2558, -21.1294)
  why: UNESCO site where tectonic plates meet — dramatic rift valley perfect for your photography and outdoor exploration focus.

- **02:00 PM — Lunch at Geysir area** (food, 45 min, $80, 64.3106, -20.3028)
  why: Cafeteria near the geothermal field offers hot meals; convenient mid-route stop to warm up.
  note: Limited options here; Icelandic lamb soup and sandwiches; simple fare but satisfying in winter cold.

- **03:15 PM — Gullfoss Waterfall** (other, 60 min, $0, 64.3271, -20.1224)
  why: Massive two-tier waterfall plunging into a canyon — one of Iceland's most photogenic natural wonders, especially dramatic in winter ice.
  note: 10 min drive from Geysir; free entry, parking ~$10; viewpoints may be icy — wear traction cleats; spray freezes on railings.

- **04:45 PM — Kerið Crater** (other, 30 min, $8, 64.0410, -20.8851)
  why: Vivid volcanic crater lake with red slopes — quick photography stop adding geological variety before dark.
  note: 40 min drive back toward Reykjavik; small entry fee; walk the rim in 20-30 min; twilight approaching.

- **06:00 PM — Dinner in downtown Reykjavik** (food, 90 min, $120, 64.1450, -21.9300)
  why: Return to city for substantial meal before northern lights hunt; Laugavegur area has varied options.
  note: 45 min drive from Kerið; area around main street — e.g., Sægreifinn for seafood or Grillmarkaðurinn for lamb.

- **08:30 PM — Northern Lights Tour** (other, 240 min, $250, 64.1466, -21.9426)
  why: Peak aurora season with long dark nights — tour operators track conditions and know best viewing spots away from city light.
  note: Tours depart ~21:00; 3-4 hours in countryside; if cloudy (60% rain), operators may reschedule; dress in warmest layers.

## Day 4 — 2027-02-15

- **02:30 PM — Gunnuhver Geothermal Area** (other, 45 min, $0, 63.8206, -22.6914)
